{{Otheruses|President}}
'''President''' was a title given to leaders of certain organizations or governments. [[Si-Di-Ri]] was [[President of the Tiss'sharl League]] until resigning from the position after an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Unidentified Tiss'shar assassin|attempt]] and a visit from [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] eight [[Standard month|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Empire 31">[[Empire 31|''Empire'' 31]]</ref>
